verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for a search and analytics engine, but the evidence pack never documents a way to define rules that fire actions on events. The only automatic behaviors shown are built-in: embedding generation when indexing into semantic_text fields, and serverless autoscaling. Neither lets users author rules. A single community remark about not paying for 'alerts' implies such a feature may exist, but it is too indirect to count as evidence of the capability.
